action.sql: SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(debit - credit), 0) FROM gl_lines WHERE entity_id = 'CA01' AND account_id = '6500' AND period BETWEEN '2026-01' AND '2026-06') AS actual, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM budgets WHERE entity_id = 'CA01' AND account_id = '6500' AND period BETWEEN '2026-01' AND '2026-06') AS budget, 100.0 * (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(debit - credit), 0) FROM gl_lines WHERE entity_id = 'CA01' AND account_id = '6500' AND period BETWEEN '2026-01' AND '2026-06') / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM budgets WHERE entity_id = 'CA01' AND account_id = '6500' AND period BETWEEN '2026-01' AND '2026-06'), 0) AS percent_used
